Our client is a well-established, privately owned industrial distribution business based in Perth’s south-east. They’ve been operating successfully for many years and supply some of WA’s best-known names in mining, construction and transport.

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you’ll be a hands-on member of a small, close-knit finance team. Your work will include:

  • Autonomous, organised and accurate, able to manage your own workload within part-time hours
